hooks.command:
bash -c 'v=$(jq -r --arg f "$1" '''($f / ".") as $p | .tool_input | getpath($p) // empty''' 2>/dev/null); if [ "$?" -ne 0 ]; then printf "bluetemberg guardrail: could not read field .%s from the hook payload (is jq installed?), so the condition cannot be evaluated. Blocking.
" "$1" >&2; exit 2; fi; fail=; bad=; if [ -n "$5" ] && [ -z "$v" ]; then fail=1; fi; if [ -n "$2" ]; then [[ "$v" =~ $2 ]]; s=$?; if [ "$s" -eq 2 ]; then bad=1; elif [ "$s" -eq 0 ]; then fail=1; fi; fi; if [ -n "$3" ]; then [[ "$v" =~ $3 ]]; s=$?; if [ "$s" -eq 2 ]; then bad=1; elif [ "$s" -ne 0 ]; then fail=1; fi; fi; if [ -n "$bad" ]; then printf "bluetemberg guardrail: the condition regex for field .%s is not valid POSIX ERE, so the condition cannot be evaluated. Blocking; fix the guardrail regex.
" "$1" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [ -n "$fail" ]; then printf "%s
" "$4" >&2; exit 2; fi' bluetemberg 'name' '^claude/' '' 'EnterWorktree requires a conventional branch name. Call EnterWorktree again with name="type/description" (e.g. feat/my-feature). Ask the user what the branch should be called if unclear. Types: feat fix chore refactor docs test' '1'

bash -c 'name=$(cat | jq -r ".name // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ -z "$name" || "$name" == claude/* ]]; then echo "EnterWorktree requires a conventional branch name. Call EnterWorktree again with name=\"type/description\" (e.g. feat/my-feature). Ask the user what the branch should be called if unclear. Types: feat fix chore refactor docs test"; exit 2; fi'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.name // empty" 2>/dev/null); repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); worktree="$repo_root/.claude/worktrees/$name"; if [[ -d "$worktree" ]]; then if [[ -f "$repo_root/.env" ]]; then cp "$repo_root/.env" "$worktree/.env" && echo "Copied .env to worktree."; fi; if [[ -f "$worktree/package.json" ]]; then npm install --prefix "$worktree" --silent && echo "Dependencies installed in worktree."; fi; fi'
